result.reason: The redline appropriately makes the cap mutual and agreement-wide, uses the preferred greater-of-12-month-fees-or-US$1 million amount, includes the required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Client payment obligations from damages. However, it omits the required mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, so it does not reach the preferred position. It also does not cleanly reach the fallback, which specifies a cap of 12 months' fees rather than the potentially higher greater-of formulation. The changes otherwise preserve the indemnity and unrelated commercial terms and are generally professionally drafted.
